attributes.contract_revision: Recommend consolidating the operational contract into a short invariant/command path and moving historical examples to structured evidence, while retaining the lessons. Separate experiment acceptance from main-branch integration. Search results and old compiler caps should display supersession and evidence scope consistently across tool/brief/laws surfaces. This roadmap is not itself an override of AGENTS.md.
attributes.diagnosis: The most recurring process weakness in the inspected reversals is promoting conditional observations into certainty: a score becomes a correctness claim, a fixed-source flag sweep becomes a universal compiler cap, a single-axis regression vetoes a coupled source reconstruction, or one classifier label becomes a prescribed cure. This is an evidence-weighted assessment, not a measured percentage attribution of all remaining blockers. Wrong TU boundaries are real but not demonstrated image-wide; missing flags remain possible but no global magic setting has been found.

deliverables: One provenance manifest from actual Ninja/link inputs: compiler binary hash, full ordered arguments, source/header hashes, per-source pragma scopes, raw object, every transformed object, final linked object and extracted fallback. Separate text, relocations, initialized data, BSS and exception metadata.

Correct progress tiers: raw stock compiler, derived compiler, machine-proven postprocessor, manual exception, unresolved and extracted fallback. Store linked/not-linked and compatibility-scaffolding provenance independently; overlapping classifications are not additive percentages.

Require baseline-object fidelity in every cv_probe mode; canonicalize effective flags, report overrides, failures and duplicate outputs. A control sensitive to the option validates that an unchanged function is informative. Do not strip source pragmas in production just to make a sweep vary.

Repair ce_eq_datum_audit through the shared fndiff API, propagate the dotless extab refutation into datadiff, and test sibling callers of changed APIs. Consolidate parsers/classifiers instead of adding another divergent implementation.

Run the strict-relocation report in shadow mode first; adjudicate the 376 newly demoted functions by resolved datum, width, addend, symbol identity and instruction operand. Calibrate known good linked SDK and deliberately bad fixtures before gating. A datum multiset alone misses operand transpositions.

Add the tool and graph suites plus representative end-to-end CLI tests to CI; use private target-bearing fixtures only in the existing private build environment. Include expected refusals, absent objects, stale outputs, pragma overrides, rule chains and missing shared APIs.
phase_1_trust_and_accounting.exit_gate: Every required analysis stage has a versioned schema and explicit PASS/FAIL/UNRESOLVED result; intentional baseline drift and wrong datum controls are caught, known-good controls pass, and raw/patched/fallback accounting reconciles to the actual link. The normal build remains checksum-green.

deliverables: For each of the 42 configured unfinished TUs, create a closure checklist covering function roster/order, source-defined inlining, prototypes/types, literal pools, data/BSS ownership, weak/helper symbols, exception records and per-TU effective flags.

Assign the 84 auto data/BSS units to typed program data, BSS/common storage, embedded assets, padding or unresolved ownership. Do not automatically emit giant C byte arrays or claim that all 2.1 MB need hand-written declarations. Asset input/extraction policy needs explicit agreement if it changes current rules.

Prioritize boundary hypotheses supported by independent GC evidence: call visibility, literal-base use, small-data interleaving, exception records and symbol order, with Xbox module names as corroboration only. Validate actual linker pooling, exported aliases, weak emission and ordering before inferring one source TU from a shared base.

Re-evaluate the existing sounds_evt/sounds merge hypothesis in isolation; it is not yet permission to concatenate files. Preserve all established exact functions and rule bindings. Source order is not automatically text address order: the prior gauntworld move needed an InLevel definition hoist and caller-specific inlining repair.
Perform data/exception preflight before spending a matching pass on the last function. The newcam and mb_blit live examples still have data claim debt.
phase_2_ownership_and_build_context.exit_gate: A TU has a bounded, evidence-backed source/build context and a complete non-text checklist before promotion. No gap/overlap or PDB-name heuristic alone is reported as recovered original ownership.

deliverables: Recover ABI, signedness/width, struct fields, virtual/inline calls, FP operation association and constant values before matching temporary/register placement. Use full target CFG and callers, not Ghidra's guessed C signature or a scalar similarity score.

Preserve the best verified trunk while explicitly allowing isolated experimental branches to pass through temporary score regressions. Existing probe --bank/--no-bank/--arbitrate facilities already help; change the policy/decision protocol rather than inventing another permutation tool. Merge only a reviewed semantic and whole-TU result.

Keep a small frontier of distinct hypotheses, such as plausible source structure, matching frame/CFG and best raw bytes, rather than deleting every state that loses fuzzy score. Bound each branch by a named next test; this is not unlimited random search or permission to regress main.

Test interacting changes together when they affect the same value web; record held-fixed variables. After type, boundary or surrounding-code changes, invalidate old caps by source/header/compiler fingerprints and rerun the relevant finite probes.

Treat count parity, register identity and fuzzy score as diagnostics, not standalone semantic invariants. Review compatibility wrappers, pads, volatile casts and stale pragmas after real structural corrections; do not remove user-approved scaffolding indiscriminately.
phase_3_non_greedy_source_experiments.exit_gate: Compare pilots by newly linked source bytes/TUs, raw rule retirements, resolved semantic/data defects and reproducible refutations, not number of probes or fuzzy points alone.
phase_3_non_greedy_source_experiments.pilot: Before another broad fleet, use one TU with a complete-data path for integration, one concrete source/ABI or wrong-datum case, and one small WebFrank raw-promotion case with new source evidence. newcam is a screened integration candidate (one unmatched function) but not a promised easy flip; its data, prior caps and fn_8006DC64 diagnosis must be read first.

deliverables: Keep existing audited WebFrank support available while prioritizing source-first retirement. A sound current-source transformation is not evidence that original source cannot compile directly. Quarantine and explicitly label pool_garbage_collect's manual exception for deeper review.

Use adjacent already-matching functions as controls for compiler/flag/TU hypotheses. Require a coherent multi-function benefit before selecting another compiler or flag profile; finite failures remain scoped to tested source/context.

Treat the existing 1.2.5s registry result as a narrow option to replace P6Frank, not evidence it replaces WebFrank. Broader adoption would need a full per-TU corpus replay, negative controls and edited-source tests.

Commission new compiler patches only after a reproducible minimal counterexample and demand census show the same mechanism across functions. Keep documented uncertainty when source reachability is unresolved.
phase_4_postprocessor_decision.exit_gate: Every remaining rule has a current source trail, explicit proof boundary and raw residual; manual exceptions and derived compilers are separate from machine-proven/stock raw matches. No universal compiler necessity claim is inferred from archive coverage alone.

deliverables: Use isolated matching and --non-matching build directories/worktrees in CI so configurations cannot contaminate one another. Test representative source edits with target-bound patchers disabled, while preserving explicitly target-independent metadata operations.

Require a complete source-built link for executable code and reconstructed program data/BSS with zero unnoticed original-object fallbacks. List any separately agreed asset inputs; a normal mod build that still links auto extracted data objects is not proof of a full source reconstruction.

Compare final relocations, symbols, section layout, exception metadata and cleaned main.dol bytes; keep the two retail exception-padding bytes an explicit packaging distinction, not hidden source-match credit.

Test boot, level transition, combat, rendering, audio, save/load and edited-source behavior on the actual supported emulator/hardware workflow before making modifiability claims. Matching on GameCube does not by itself establish portability to other targets.
phase_5_completion_and_modifiability.exit_gate: A clean rebuild accounts for every executable byte and program datum by source or a declared reviewed exception, reproduces the verified target, and representative edited builds compile/link and behave as intended without retail-hash-bound patching.

subject: project:gdl
value: Recommended revision plan, NOT an approved policy change or a claim that stock-compiler-only completion is proved possible. Preserve the checksum-green best branch while replacing score-led local search with controlled source-reconstruction experiments and complete-TU integration. Repair trust/accounting first; then work one integration pilot, one source/ABI reconstruction cohort and one bounded raw-promotion cohort. Do not resume a general compiler-decompilation or global compiler-swap campaign without a shared residual census and a discriminating test.
